entities.name: Rashmi
entities.description: An elvish aether-seer whose matter transporter won the Inventors' Fair; she becomes Tezzeret's captive patronage inventor and escapes after glimpsing other planes.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: The metal-handed Grand Consul and Rashmi's patron, a cruel tyrant who demands progress and threatens to kill inventors who fail him.

entities.name: Mitul
entities.description: Rashmi's vedalken assistant and friend, whom Tezzeret threatens to kill.

entities.name: Bhavin
entities.description: A dwarf metalworker who placed fourth at the Fair with his massive construction automatons; Tezzeret throws him out.

entities.name: Sana
entities.description: An aerowright and fair winner whose empty workstation shows she was dismissed.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: Rashmi's friend, a metalsmith planeswalker who rescues her with a metal construct and leads her to the renegades.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker in black not named on this page, who accompanies Saheeli and was promised fun with Tezzeret.

entities.name: Consulate functionaries
entities.description: Consulate staff who serve Tezzeret, attend the inventors, and remove those he dismisses.

entities.name: The Consulate
entities.description: Kaladesh's governing body, which claims all that is made in the Inquirium.

entities.name: The Renegades
entities.description: The rebel movement into which Saheeli welcomes Rashmi.

entities.name: The Gatewatch
entities.description: Planeswalkers distracted during Tezzeret's showdown with Pia.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: The renegade whose showdown with Tezzeret was a cover for taking the winning inventors.

entities.name: Spire Inquirium
entities.description: The pristine Consulate workshop in the Spire where winning inventors are kept and work under Tezzeret.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: The city of Kaladesh over which Rashmi leaps from the Spire.

entities.name: The beetle inquirium
entities.description: Rashmi and Mitul's workplace where they first succeeded at matter transport and where Mitul works.

entities.name: The Great Conduit
entities.description: The pattern of aether that Rashmi feels through the modular core.

entities.name: Phantom dimensions
entities.description: Dimensions whose auras provide pathways for the transporter; Rashmi finds they are real other realities.

entities.name: Rashmi's matter transporter
entities.description: An aether transporter archway that collapses spatial dimensions to move matter, which Tezzeret takes.

entities.name: Rashmi's original transporter ring
entities.description: The ring that was Rashmi's first transporter, used to send her warning note to Mitul.

entities.name: Bhavin's automaton
entities.description: Bhavin's towering construct that Tezzeret uses to test the transporter.

entities.name: Saheeli's construct
entities.description: A metal construct Saheeli shapes around Rashmi to carry her to safety.

entities.name: Inventors' Fair
entities.description: The fair that Rashmi won with her transporter.

entities.name: Aether
entities.description: The blue energy that powers the transporter and the Inquirium.

events.summary: Rashmi works alone in the Spire Inquirium, missing her assistant Mitul whom the functionaries refuse to bring.
events.quote: It had been four weeks since she'd asked for Mitul to be brought on

events.summary: Rashmi notices that aerowright Sana's workstation was emptied after Tezzeret's first progress check.
events.quote: The sight of aerowright Sana's empty workstation dissolved any spirit of comradery

events.summary: Tezzeret arrives for a progress check and bends Bhavin's automaton's arm, then throws Bhavin out and takes his invention.
Tezzeret tells the inventors that anything made in the Inquirium belongs to the Consulate.
events.quote: "Anything made in this Inquirium belongs to the Consulate."

events.summary: Rashmi presents the scaled-up transporter and works out the answer to Tezzeret's nonlinear-transport question.
events.quote: If I insert an attenuator into the aether-loop

events.summary: Tezzeret has a functionary dismissed for objecting to rerouting aether and threatens to terminate Rashmi if she cannot move Bhavin's automaton by the next check.
events.quote: "If you don't, you will be terminated."

events.summary: Four weeks later, the other inventors have been moved out, and Rashmi, pushed to exhaustion, finishes the transporter on the morning of the progress check.
Setting the target, Rashmi's mind is pulled through the phantom dimensions and she glimpses many other worlds before Tezzeret's footsteps pull her back.
events.quote: And then she was Rashmi, the elf, kneeling on the floor in the Inquirium

events.summary: Rashmi tells Tezzeret of the phantom dimensions; he laughs at her, declares the transporter his, and dismisses her.
events.quote: "This beautiful creation is now mine. And thus I am done with you."

events.summary: Tezzeret threatens to kill Rashmi and then bring Mitul to complete the transporter and kill him too, and sends functionaries to fetch Mitul.
events.quote: I will bring your little friend—Mitul, I believe was his name—to complete the transporter

events.summary: Rashmi chooses to save Mitul over the dimensions she has seen.
Rashmi secretly sends a warning note to Mitul through the old transporter ring while distracting Tezzeret.
events.quote: dropping the ball of paper through the ring. It disappeared.

events.summary: Rashmi rigs the transporter so the demonstration backfires; Tezzeret's test sends the automaton onto a box, crushing the desk and shattering the window.
events.quote: Too big to fit, Bhavin's masterpiece crushed the box

events.summary: Rashmi leaps out of the window on a harness cable and escapes Tezzeret above Ghirapur.
events.quote: she sprinted to the gaping hole and leapt out into the swirling aether beyond.

events.summary: Saheeli rescues Rashmi in her construct and tells her Mitul is safe.
Rashmi realizes Saheeli knew the transporter's implications and senses the planeswalker nature in her; Saheeli welcomes her to the renegade movement.
events.quote: "Welcome to the renegade movement, my friend. I have much to tell you."

relations.quote: under orders from her patron, Tezzeret

relations.note: He is her friend and assistant.
relations.quote: how she missed her vedalken assistant Mitul

relations.note: Saheeli calls Rashmi her friend and rescues her.
relations.quote: "Welcome to the renegade movement, my friend.

relations.note: He threatens to end her life.
relations.quote: You will do as I say, or I will END you.

relations.note: He dismisses and takes his invention.
relations.quote: This piece of garbage is not yours .
sucked papers and tools out into the sky high above Ghirapur.
